::: {#perfil}

Research assistant at the GAIA Lab, applying deep learning models to satellite imagery and environmental challenges. MSc student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science at FGV EMAp, with double BSc degrees in Applied Mathematics and in Data Science and AI. She also researches computer vision at CBPF.

## Education

- MSc student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science, FGV EMAp.
- BSc in Data Science and AI, FGV EMAp.
- BSc in Applied Mathematics, FGV EMAp.

## Interests

Deep learning, computer vision, and LiDAR.
